data.narrative:
Mythic is a Series D semiconductor company that has raised $125M to date. The valuation analysis draws on a private-company peer set of 8 firms and public comparables (ALAB, NVDA, AMD) across the Chips & Semiconductors sector.

Two valuation methods are applicable. Stage-progression analysis applies a 1.5x multiplier to total capital raised, yielding $188M. Peer-median triangulation uses four same-sector, same/adjacent-stage comparables: Etched ($5.0B, Series E), Ayar Labs ($3.8B, Series E), Tenstorrent ($2.7B, Series D), and DEEPX ($529M, Series C). The median across this set is $3.2B, with a range of $529M to $5.0B. Public-comp anchoring cannot be applied due to absence of revenue data. The public sector median P/S multiple stands at 18.4x across three tickers, but lacks target-specific revenue to deploy meaningfully.

The triangulated analysis across applicable methods supports a range of $159M (low) to $3.7B (high), with a median of $1.7B. The wide dispersion reflects the early-stage nature of the target relative to more mature Series E peers and the material valuation variance within the semiconductor frontier-tech segment. Key uncertainties include commercial traction velocity, technical differentiation durability, and comparability of peer business models at different stages.
